source_video.note: graphics are in the top 720x640; the creator's cam fills the bottom half and is ignored

frame_u: 1u = 1 px of the 720-wide reference = 1.5 px of the 1080-wide output. Top half = 720u x 640u.

box.persist: the two boxes stay on screen for the whole video; only their contents change

name_label.two_lines: long names wrap to 2 lines, e.g. 'Horizontal Scaling'

ours_on_cream.decision: plain black #0A0A0A Poppins 800 ~47u, no outline/pill/shadow (creator-approved after comparing 6 options)
ours_on_cream.why: reference labels were white with outline over a dark video; on the cream bg white has no contrast
reference -0.078em fused the outlined letters; creator asked for a little spacing

primitives.box_pop: scale easeOutBack(c1~1.7) from 0, 0.25 s; measured widths 139,251,305,297,282,275 (-> 278) at 24 fps; blur in first frames
primitives.element_pop: scale .5+.5*easeOutBack(c1 2.6), 0.26 s, peak 1.10-1.12 at 0.12 s, opacity 0->1 in 0.1 s, blur 4px->0
primitives.text_wipe: left-to-right reveal with blur, 0.45 s (word or line)
primitives.arrow_draw: directional wipe, 0.10-0.15 s (2-3 frames at 24 fps)
primitives.name_label_in: opacity+blur+slight scale, ~0.3 s (0.15 s after a cut)
primitives.state_changes: hard cuts (labels, clearing the boxes): never a fade

text_in_box_u.title: ~25 bold, 2 lines max (e.g. 'Continuous Integration')
text_in_box_u.label: ~19 medium/semi-bold ('application')
text_in_box_u.caption: ~13 in the original; use >=15 in new work
